title: Tooling: replay balanced Fano 2.91× faster with identical exhaustive streams
head: 4fad623a1e4ca06959f4326e221c2f8d9125c269
body:
The historical balanced-Fano checker transposes a complete binary matrix at every meet-in-the-middle leaf. This tooling improvement propagates packed columns with exact Python integer operations and reconstructs a retained prefix matrix only when a witness is found. Both exhaustive streams, first-match behavior, witnesses, budgets and rejection checks are preserved. **No new κ or search-domain claim.**

Five sequential, alternating fresh-process pairs on CPython 3.13.2 / macOS arm64 measured median search time **5.969 → 2.051 seconds (2.91×)** and peak process RSS **162,381,824 → 113,180,672 bytes (30.3% lower)**. Every sample matches every original result field. These measurements cover this fixed historical check, not the selected supplier replay or multiplication runtime.

Validation:

- Compare all **559,872** half assignments pointwise with the pinned original, retaining both original stream hashes and all **258,156** prefix keys. The covered full domain remains `6^14 = 78,364,164,096` local assignments via meet-in-the-middle.
- Add independent dense column controls, exact positive-witness/early-stop comparisons, and a missing-leaf mutation that preserves the negative Boolean but fails receipt equality. Input and budget failures retain their original exceptions.
- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 make verify-tests`: **555 tests in 85 isolated modules and 20 patch checks pass**. The six new tests also pass under `-O`; the affected audit passes under `-S`; selected-record and whitespace checks pass.
- Regenerate only the historical certificate's changed source binding. A test restores that one binding and verifies the SHA256 of the entire original certificate. The selected frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged.

Reproduce with standard-library Python 3.11+ (benchmark RSS reporting supports macOS/Linux):

```sh
python3 -B research/balanced-fano-performance/benchmark.py --rounds 5
```

Expected: `PASS_IDENTICAL_COMPLETE_RESULTS`. `research/balanced-fano-performance/README.md` contains the equivalence argument and review map; `RESULT.json` retains all samples and exact source pins; `VALIDATION.json` records coverage. Full `make verify` and the selected supplier cold replay were not rerun for this isolated historical-checker change. Remote CI is separate from local validation.

Exact base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. OS-random assignment seed **91**, verification engineering. No pinned sprint issue existed, so the claim is local. Final overlap review covered 567 open PRs through #748; nearby algebra, geometry, footprint and streaming optimizations concern other checks and supply no code here.

Credit Douglas R. Colkitt's original balanced-Fano checker, scoped negative result and dense controls. Prepared by **Wentao Li with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, under Apache-2.0; Contributor profiles: [GitHub: VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [X: @Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor). Detailed predecessor attribution is in `NOTICE.md`. This changes no inherited mathematical assumptions and is not a formal proof of the full multiplication theorem.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
